chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Della Reese
summary: An agent sent Reese to the Howard Theatre and she toured with him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Della Reese? I was going to Washington, D.C., and I needed a girl vocalist singer to go with me. And, the fellow, one of the agents in the office that did the, I'm opening tomorrow, you know, just happened to bring Della Reese's name out. He said, I've got a girl in Detroit that I can get for you for that week, you know. So I said can she sing? You know, I asked him different questions. He said she'll do all right for you. You know?

So, I had him send for her, and she met me at the Howard Theatre in Washington, D.C.. I didn't get a chance to rehearse with her too much. I talked over a couple of numbers back stage and we got the band together. And, she went out after I opened it up with 2 or 3 numbers. Then, I brought her on to sing those 2 numbers. From then on, she was with me there for quite a while on up through the time that I was with Nat King Cole on a tour. And she was at the Savoy and everything. She started to, after Nat King Cole's tour, then she went out with the same agent that she had, and he got a
recording session for her, you know, (inaudible).
